product_summary: Real product range per own website (jyoti.co.in, product menu): CNC Turning / Turn-Mill Centres — DX 60 & DX 100 linear-tooling turning centre, Zebra CNC chucker, DX Series turning/turn-mill, AX Series high-precision turning/turn-mill, DXG Series turning centres with automation, BTM 100 blank turning with automation, TS Series twin-spindle twin-turret with gantry robot, AWT 22 alloy-wheel turning, VTL Series heavy-duty vertical turning lathes, VTL Large Series ram-type vertical turning lathe, VST 160 vertical shaft turning machine, AT/ATM Series inverted turning lathes, i-Sect oval turning centres. CNC Vertical Machining Centres — Tachyon high-speed drill-tap, Mill Tap C-frame, PX nvu C-frame VMC, RX/RAX high-speed VMC, RDX C-frame VMC, VMC Performance series, VMC Performance nvu, VMC Performance Large T-base, K Mill nvu bridge-type VMC, KX/K2X bridge-type VMC, NX high-performance double-column VMC, EX-F moving-column VMC, NX Large double-column VMC. CNC Horizontal Machining Centres — HX, HSX, HP Next-Gen HMC 2.0. CNC 5-Axis Machining Centres — Tachyon Beta, ABX blade machining centre, MuTech 6, U Mill, GU Five gantry 5-axis, KX Five nvu bridge-type, MX 4, EX Series moving-column, KX Large double-column, KXG gantry-type. CNC Multi-Tasking Machines — MTX, MX mill-turn, TMX 200. Plus Industry 4.0 / '7th Sense' AI monitoring software and Preci-Protect safety AI. Also a foundry and sheet-metal shop in-house (captive castings/fabrications, not evidenced as sold separately).
comment: HS 845710 (machining centres for working metal) — exact match: the bulk of the catalogue (VMC, HMC, double-column, 5-axis, gantry machining centres) is precisely 845710. HS 845811 (horizontal NC lathes) — partial match: covers the DX/AX/Zebra/TS/AWT turning and turn-mill centres, but does NOT cover the VTL Series and VST 160 vertical turning lathes (vertical, not horizontal — should be 845891/845899) nor the AT/ATM inverted vertical turning lathes. Declaration is also incomplete: no code for CNC multi-tasking mill-turn machines (MTX/MX/TMX — arguably 845710 or 845811 depending on dominant function, needs line-level check), no code for separately supplied gantry-robot automation units (847950/847989), no code for parts/accessories (846693), no code for the Industry 4.0 / 7th Sense AI software and monitoring (would be 8523/9973-type, not a goods line). Industry claim 'Металлургия и горнодобыча' (metallurgy & mining) is a MISCLASSIFICATION: the company is a machine-tool builder (HS chapter 84, metal-cutting machine tools), not a metallurgical/mining producer. It sells capital equipment TO metallurgy, mining, power, oil & gas, railway, infrastructure, aerospace, EMS and EV customers (per the site's 'Solutions' sections) — that is end-user industry, not own output. No trader signs: own manufacturing (foundry, assembly, sheet-metal, paint shops listed under 'Manufacturing Excellence'), own brand, own R&D and design engineering, foreign subsidiaries in France, Germany and Canada plus the Huron brand — consistent with a genuine OEM manufacturer, not a trader. All product claims above are from the company's own website and are therefore 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — no customs line was available in this task to corroborate any specific HS code or shipment. Per project rule 3, the HS mismatch/omissions are NOT grounds for rejection: company is retained, declared codes corrected/expanded to 845710 + 845811 + 845891/845899 (VTL) + 846693 (parts) + 847950/847989 (robot automation units), verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Revenue, export volumes, CIN/PAN and shipment records were not researched in this task — null.
